clue.text: Staff swindler

definitions.meaning: a shepherd's or bishop's hooked staff
a cheat or criminal

explanation.definitionFit: A shepherd's hooked stick and a cheating criminal share this word, so both senses fit.

clue.text: Padres are disposed to disperse

indicators.note: disposed here means set out in a new order, so the letters of the clue word before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Priests in a group are inclined to scatter.
explanation.definitionFit: To scatter something widely is to distribute it over an area, a synonym.

clue.text: Little Edward heartened by the wife he married

indicators.note: given a heart by, so the word for wife is placed in the middle of the short name

parts.note: Ed is a short form of the name Edward
a wife is a spouse

explanation.surface: Young Ed is cheered by the woman he wed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartened by' means given a centre, so the wife goes in the middle; 'the' and 'he' are link words, and the definition is the bare past tense.
explanation.definitionFit: Espoused is a formal synonym for wedded.

clue.text: Limb of Foreign Office to abandon peace policy

parts.note: FO is the abbreviation for the Foreign Office, Britain's foreign ministry
to stop disarming and build up weapons again is to rearm

explanation.surface: A branch of the Foreign Office decides to drop its pacifist stance.
explanation.definitionFit: The part of the arm between elbow and wrist is a limb section.

clue.text: Political organisation which should go like clockwork

definitions.meaning: a campaigning group with a shared cause, like the labour cause
the works of a watch or clock are called by this name

explanation.definitionFit: A campaigning group with a cause and the mechanism of a watch both carry this name.

clue.text: American sweetheart has to straighten hair with beeswax

parts.note: honey is an American term of endearment
to tidy the hair with a toothed tool is to comb it

explanation.surface: A US darling tidies her hair with a wax product.
explanation.definitionFit: Bees build their hexagonal cells of wax, so the wax structure is a fitting definition by example.

clue.text: Maybe mulled wine, a whiff of which dispersed a Parisian mob

definitions.text: a whiff of which dispersed a Parisian mob

parts.note: wine is made from grapes, used loosely here
mulled wine is heated and served warm

explanation.surface: Some spiced wine is linked to a historical crowd being scattered in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: Napoleon claimed to have cleared a Paris mob in 1795 with 'a whiff of grapeshot'; 'Maybe' marks the loose wine-to-grapes link.
explanation.definitionFit: Artillery scattershot of small balls was used by Napoleon against a Paris crowd, famously described as a whiff.

clue.text: Caught a bus to travel 100 mph

definitions.meaning: boarded a vehicle
to do a ton, a hundred miles an hour, is to go a ton

explanation.definitionFit: Boarding a vehicle and moving at a hundred miles an hour (the slang ton) both fit the phrase.

clue.text: Be up against a proviso

parts.note: a but is a condition or objection

explanation.definitionFit: To border or touch something is to be pressed up against it.

clue.text: Sweetheart, the romance is finished

parts.note: romance is love
finished means done

explanation.definitionFit: A beloved partner is a dear one, a synonym.

clue.text: His product fills that little brown jug

definitions.text: His product fills that little brown jug

parts.words: His product fills that little brown jug
parts.note: the jug in the old drinking song is filled with beer, so the man meant is the one who makes beer

explanation.definitionFit: A beer maker produces the ale that fills a drinking jug.

clue.text: The day Caesar should have side stepped?

indicators.note: stepped is read as moved around, so the four letters of the word before shift position

explanation.surface: The date Julius Caesar ought to have avoided.
explanation.walkthrough: Caesar was warned to beware the Ides of March, the day he was killed; 'side stepped' reads as avoided in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The mid-month date of the Roman calendar was when Caesar was assassinated.

clue.text: Economise to construct new drainage

parts.note: re- is the prefix meaning again or anew
a trench is a ditch dug for drainage

explanation.surface: Cut costs by digging a new drain.
explanation.definitionFit: To cut spending is to cut back, a synonym.

clue.text: Study an offer made by a competitor

parts.note: to con is to study or learn by heart
a tender is a formal offer

explanation.surface: A bid examined, made by a rival.
explanation.definitionFit: A rival in a contest is a synonym for one who competes.

clue.text: To the navy trouble is on the way!

definitions.text: To the navy trouble is on the way!

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy
ado means fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: Sailors are warned of a storm approaching.
explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue is a storm warning to sailors; RN is the Royal Navy.
explanation.definitionFit: A violent rotating storm brings trouble to ships at sea.

clue.text: French sovereign worth 20 francs

definitions.meaning: a French emperor, the Corsican or his nephew
a French gold coin worth twenty francs was named after the emperor

explanation.definitionFit: A French emperor and the gold twenty-franc coin bearing his name share the word.

clue.text: A Western alliance needs my physical science

parts.note: NATO is the North Atlantic Treaty Organization

explanation.surface: An alliance of western nations requires my scientific knowledge.
explanation.definitionFit: The study of bodily structure is a physical science.

clue.text: Peer for a third of a sovereign on an English isle

parts.note: the noble was an old English gold coin worth 6s 8d, a third of a pound
the Isle of Man, in the Irish Sea

explanation.surface: A lord for the price of a fraction of a gold coin on a British island.
explanation.walkthrough: A sovereign is a pound coin; the old noble coin was worth 6s 8d, a third of it. The Isle of Man is a Crown dependency, loosely 'English' here.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the aristocracy is a peer of the realm.

clue.text: Brave despite suffering from sunburn

definitions.meaning: a Native American warrior, in an old and now offensive term
sunburn turns the skin red

explanation.definitionFit: An old, now offensive term for a Native American warrior, and literally burnt red hide.

clue.text: Strike call by editor who suddenly spots libellous item

definitions.meaning: a halt to work by workers

definitions.text: call by editor who suddenly spots libellous item
definitions.meaning: an editor halting the presses would cry to hold the printing

explanation.definitionFit: A walkout by workers, and an editor's cry to halt printing, both fit the word.

clue.text: A capital orchestra too

parts.note: LSO is the London Symphony Orchestra, London being the capital

explanation.definitionFit: As well, in addition, is a synonym.

clue.text: American head as an ancient inn sign

definitions.meaning: a US president
a bunch of ivy hung outside a tavern once advertised wine

explanation.definitionFit: A US president's surname, and the ivy bunch once hung as a tavern sign.

clue.text: Trim a tree

definitions.meaning: trim as an adjective means neat and smart
a coniferous evergreen

explanation.definitionFit: Neat and smart in appearance, and a type of evergreen conifer.

clue.text: Book guide to forbidden books

definitions.meaning: an alphabetical list at the back of a book
the Catholic Church's list of banned books

explanation.definitionFit: An alphabetical reference list at the back of a book, and the church's banned list.

clue.text: Early English viewpoints

definitions.meaning: a Germanic people who settled England
perspectives or slants on a subject

explanation.definitionFit: A Germanic tribe settling early England, and perspectives on a topic.

clue.text: Fleecing a woman who is obviously engaged or married

parts.note: she refers to a woman
a ring on the finger shows engagement or marriage

explanation.surface: Swindling a lady who visibly has a fiancé or husband.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fleecing' is both cheating and clipping a sheep's wool; the ring is the visible sign of being engaged or married.
explanation.definitionFit: Clipping the wool off a sheep is a literal synonym for fleecing.

clue.text: Not above suggesting abasement

definitions.meaning: underneath, lower down
beneath one's dignity, as in a low act

explanation.definitionFit: Underneath in position, and beneath one's dignity, both fit.

clue.text: Pigeon expert invests in an investor

indicators.note: invests is read as clothes or surrounds, so the pigeon expert's word wraps around the short word

parts.note: a pigeon fancier breeds and races pigeons

explanation.surface: A bird enthusiast puts money into a backer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'invests' means clothes or surrounds, not puts money in; 'an' is a link word before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A person dealing in large sums of money is a financier, one who backs ventures.
